docs.title: Entity Relationship Diagrams
docs.text:
Entity-Relationship diagrams generated using LinkML's ER Diagram generator.

FOF-CT defines two complementary modalities:

  • FOF-bas-CT (ball-and-stick): The Spot and Trace are the mandatory primary data. The raw localizations from which Spots were extracted may optionally be reported in the Demultiplexing table.
  • FOF-vol-CT (volumetric): Individual SM Localizations and their quality metrics are the mandatory primary data. Spots and Traces (post-processing outputs) are optional.

In both modalities the ID chain is identical: Loc_ID (n→1) Spot_ID (n→1) Trace_ID.

docs.title: ER Diagram — FOF-vol-CT

Entity-Relationship diagrams for the FOF-vol-CT (volumetric) modality, generated using LinkML's ER Diagram generator.

FOF-vol-CT comprises 15 tables: all 12 FOF-bas-CT tables plus 3 volumetric-specific tables. The SM Localization Data table (table 13) and SM Localization Quality table (table 14) are mandatory. The Undecoded SM Localization table (table 15) is optional.

The SM Localization event is the primary data unit. Spots and Traces are optional post-processing outputs.

The DNA-Spot/Trace Data core table is the only mandatory table; all other 11 tables are optional but recommended. Each table schema imports fof_bas_ct_common for shared slots, the Software class, and enumerations.

docs.title: Class: Cell
docs.text: A single Cell identified in a FOF-bas-CT experiment. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT Cell Data table. The cell_id field uniquely identifies each Cell and links to the core table, the Sub-Cell ROI Data table, and the Cell/ROI Mapping table. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns (e.g. Cell_Size, Cell_Volume, Cell_Cycle_State, RNA_Spot_Count) via open schema. At least one such user-defined column MUST be present per submission.

docs.title: Class: CellTable
docs.text: The Cell Data table of a FOF-bas-CT dataset (namespace: 4dn_FOF-CT_cell). This class represents the entire file: it holds all dataset-level provenance metadata (recorded as header lines in the TSV serialisation) together with the full collection of Cells (recorded as data rows). This table is optional but recommended. Analogous to the MappingSet class in SSSOM.

docs.title: Class: ExtraCellROI
docs.text: A single extracellular structure ROI (e.g. a tissue section or organoid) identified in a FOF-bas-CT experiment. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT Extra-Cell ROI Data table. The extra_cell_roi_id field uniquely identifies each ROI and links to the core table, the RNA Spot Data table, and the Cell Data table. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns (e.g. ROI_Volume, Cell_Count). At least one such user-defined column MUST be present per submission.

docs.title: Class: Localization
docs.text: A single individual localisation event contributing to the final position of a bright DNA Spot in a multiplexed FISH experiment (e.g. MERFISH). Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the CSV data section of the FOF-CT Spot Demultiplexing table. The spot_id field links each Localization to its parent Spot in the core table (or RNA Spot Data table); it may be NA when the localisation could not be assigned to any Spot. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns (e.g. Hyb, Brightness, Fit_Quality).

docs.title: Class: LocalizationMixin
docs.text: Mixin capturing the shared concept of a single localization event across FOF-CT modalities. Used by Localization (demultiplexing), SMLocalization (vol_core), and UndecodedLocalization (undecoded). All three classes represent the same atomic measurement unit — the sub-pixel position of a detected fluorescence emission event — but differ in context, mandatory columns, and table role.

docs.title: Class: RNASpot
docs.text: A single detected RNA bright Spot corresponding to one RNA transcript location detected alongside Chromatin Tracing. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the CSV data section of the FOF-CT RNA Spot Data table. The rna_spot_id links each RNASpot to the RNA Quality and RNA Biological Data tables; the trace_id links this RNA Spot to a DNA chromatin Trace in the core table and Trace Data table. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns via open schema.

docs.title: Class: RNASpotBiologicalRecord
docs.text: A single row in the RNA Spot Biological Data table. Each instance captures one or more user-defined biological properties for a specific RNA bright Spot identified by RNA_Spot_ID. RNA_Spot_ID values must be unique across the dataset, linking to the corresponding record in the RNA Spot Data table (table 4). docs.title: Class: ROIMapping
docs.text: A single boundary record for one Cell, Sub-Cell ROI, or Extra-Cell ROI in a FOF-bas-CT experiment. Each instance corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT Cell/ROI Mapping table. Exactly one of the three identifier slots (sub_cell_roi_id, cell_id, extra_cell_roi_id) must be populated per file; the choice of identifier must be consistent across all rows of a given submission. The roi_boundaries slot holds the boundary coordinates in the format specified by roi_boundaries_format in the table header. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns.

docs.title: Class: Spot
docs.text: A single DNA-FISH bright Spot detected in a ball-and-stick Chromatin Tracing experiment. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT core table and represents a specific genomic target sequence localised in 3D space and assigned to a chromatin Trace.

    - value: '1.23'

    rank: 1000
    owner: Spot
    domain_of:
    - LocalizationMixin
    - Spot
    - RNASpot
    range: float
    required: true

    rank: 1000
    domain: Spot
    owner: Spot
    domain_of:
    - Spot
    range: integer

docs.title: Class: SubCellROI
docs.text: A single sub-cellular structure ROI (e.g. nucleolus, nuclear lamina, PML body, chromosome domain) identified in a FOF-bas-CT experiment. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT Sub-Cell ROI Data table. The sub_cell_roi_id field uniquely identifies each ROI and links to the core table, the Cell Data table, and the Cell/ROI Mapping table. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns (e.g. ROI_Volume, ROI_Area). At least one such user-defined column MUST be present per submission.

docs.title: Class: Trace
docs.text: A single chromatin Trace representing global properties associated with an entire polymeric trace rather than with individual Spots. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the CSV data section of the FOF-CT Trace Data table. The trace_id links each Trace to the core table and to the RNA Spot Data table. IMPORTANT: this class MUST contain at least one user-defined optional column describing trace-level properties (e.g., Allele, RNA_Expression, Lamina_Distance). User-defined columns are accommodated via open schema.

docs.title: Slot: additional_tables
docs.text: List of additional FOF-CT table namespaces being submitted alongside this table, separated by commas in the TSV header. Written as #Additional_Tables: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: cell_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for a Cell. Links to the Cell Data table.

docs.title: Slot: cell_type
docs.text: The type of cells present in this dataset, expressed using an ontology term from the Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO). Examples include "Cell in tissue" or "Cell in organoid". Written as #Cell_Type: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: cells
docs.text: The complete collection of Cells constituting this dataset. Each Cell corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation. At least one user-defined optional column (e.g. Cell_Size, Cell_Volume) MUST be present in every submitted Cell Data table.

docs.title: Slot: centroid_intensity
docs.text: Signal intensity of the centroid pixel of the Spot. Conditionally required in the Spot Quality table when intensity metrics are reported.

docs.title: Slot: channel_name
docs.text: The name of the imaging channel used for this Spot (e.g. 510/25). Mandatory in the Spot Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: chrom
docs.text: Chromosome name using BED (Browser Extensible Data) convention (e.g., chr3, chrY, chr2_random).

docs.title: Slot: chrom_end
docs.text: Non-inclusive end coordinate on the chromosome for the genomic target sequence associated with this Spot, following BED convention.

docs.title: Slot: chrom_start
docs.text: 0-based start coordinate on the chromosome for the genomic target sequence associated with this Spot, following BED convention.

docs.title: Slot: description
docs.text: Free-text description of the experiment and of the data recorded in this table. Should provide sufficient detail for interpretation and reproducibility. Written as #Description: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: experimenter_contact
docs.text: Email address of the person who performed the experiment. Written as #Experimenter_Contact: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: experimenter_name
docs.text: Full name of the person who performed the experiment. Written as #Experimenter_Name: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: extra_cell_roi_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for an extracellular structure ROI (e.g., tissue, organoid). Links to the Extra-Cell ROI Data table.

docs.title: Slot: extra_cell_roi_type
docs.text: The type of extracellular structure ROI within which cells are embedded, expressed using an EFO 'organism part' child term (e.g. Tissue, Organoid). Conditionally required when extracellular structure ROIs are identified and reported in a dedicated Extra-Cell ROI Data table. Written as #Extra_Cell_ROI_Type: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: extra_cell_rois
docs.text: The complete collection of extracellular ROIs constituting this dataset. Each ExtraCellROI corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation. At least one user-defined optional column (e.g. ROI_Volume, Cell_Count) MUST be present in every submitted Extra-Cell ROI Data table.

docs.title: Slot: fluor
docs.text: Fluorescent channel in which this localization event was detected (e.g. DAPI, GFP, Cy5, Alexa647). Mandatory in both the Spot Demultiplexing and Undecoded SM Localization tables.

docs.title: Slot: fluorophore_name
docs.text: The name of the fluorophore used for this Spot (e.g. AlexaFluor_488). Mandatory in the Spot Quality table.

docs.title: fof_bas_ct
docs.text:
Root schema for the FISH Omics Format for Chromatin Tracing - Ball-and-Stick modality (FOF-bas-CT). Imports all twelve table schemas that together constitute the complete FOF-bas-CT data model. The DNA-Spot/Trace Data core table is the only mandatory table; all other 11 tables are optional but recommended. Each table schema imports fof_bas_ct_common for shared slots, the Software class, and enumerations.

URI: https://w3id.org/fof-ct/bas

docs.title: Slot: fof_ct_version
docs.text: Version of the FOF-CT format used in this file. Always the first line of the file header (##FOF-CT_Version=).

docs.title: Slot: frame_id
docs.text: Unique integer identifier for the imaging frame in which this undecoded localization event was detected. Used in the Undecoded SM Localization table.

docs.title: Slot: gene_id
docs.text: Official gene identifier corresponding to rna_name. The type of identifier used (e.g. Ensembl gene ID, NCBI Gene ID) must be declared in the gene_id_type header field.

docs.title: Slot: gene_id_type
docs.text: Type of gene identifier used in the gene_id column (e.g. Ensembl_V38, NCBI_Gene). Written as ##Gene_ID_Type= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: genome_assembly
docs.text: Genome build used for Chrom, Chrom_Start and Chrom_End coordinates. The 4DN Data Portal accepts GRCh38 (human) and GRCm38 (mouse). When the genome under study contains an INSERTION or DELETION the value must use the mandatory 'custom-build:' prefix followed by a descriptive name (e.g., custom-build:GRCm38+pJT039(insertion)). Written as ##Genome_Assembly= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: goodness_of_fit
docs.text: Metric quantifying how well the fitted model matches the observed signal (e.g. chi-squared, R-squared). Optional (but standardised name) in the Spot Quality table; recommended in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: intensity_measurement_method
docs.text: Method used to perform intensity measurements, including how digital signals were converted to photon counts. Written as #Intensity_Measurement_Method: in the file header. Conditionally required when any intensity metric is reported.

docs.title: Slot: intensity_unit
docs.text: Unit used to represent intensity measurements in this table. Written as ##Intensity_Unit= in the file header. Conditionally required when any intensity metric is reported.

docs.title: Slot: lab_name
docs.text: Name of the laboratory where the experiment was performed. Written as #Lab_Name: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: loc_id
docs.text: A unique integer identifier for an individual localization event. Loc_ID values are unique across the entire dataset. Serves as primary key in the Spot Demultiplexing, SM Localization Data, and Undecoded SM Localization tables, and as a foreign key in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: localizations
docs.text: The complete collection of Localization events constituting this dataset. Each Localization corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: modification
docs.text: Description of the nature and genomic position of a DNA insertion or deletion in the genome under study. Conditionally required when genome_assembly uses the 'custom-build:' prefix. Written as ##Modification= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: peak_intensity
docs.text: Signal intensity of the brightest pixel within the Spot boundary. Conditionally required in the Spot Quality table when intensity metrics are reported.

docs.title: Slot: photon_count
docs.text: Number of photons detected for this localization event or Spot. Optional (but standardised name) in the Spot Quality table; recommended in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: raw_x
docs.text: X coordinate of this Spot before any post-processing corrections (drift correction, chromatic correction, etc.). Same unit as X.

docs.title: Slot: raw_y
docs.text: Y coordinate of this Spot before any post-processing corrections. Same unit as Y.

docs.title: Slot: raw_z
docs.text: Z coordinate of this Spot before any post-processing corrections. Same unit as Z.

docs.title: Slot: rna_name
docs.text: Official name of the gene from which the targeted RNA is transcribed (e.g. ACTB, GAPDH). Should follow HGNC (human) or MGI (mouse) gene nomenclature.

docs.title: Slot: rna_spot_biological_records
docs.text: The complete collection of RNASpotBiologicalRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation and must include at least one user-defined biological property column.

docs.title: Slot: rna_spot_id
docs.text: Unique integer identifier for an RNA bright Spot, unique across the entire dataset. Used as a primary key in the RNA Spot Data table and as a foreign key in the RNA Quality and RNA Biological Data tables.

docs.title: Slot: rna_spot_quality_records
docs.text: The complete collection of RNASpotQualityRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation and must include at least one user-defined quality metric column.

docs.title: Slot: rna_spots
docs.text: The complete collection of RNA Spots constituting this dataset. Each RNASpot corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: roi_boundaries
docs.text: Boundary coordinates for this Cell or ROI, encoded in the format specified by roi_boundaries_format in the table header. For the OME ROI Polygon model, coordinates are provided as a space-separated list of "x,y" pairs (e.g. "12.5,40.2 13.1,41.0 ..."). For OBJ 3D mesh format, the field contains the vertex and face list for the boundary mesh.

docs.title: Slot: roi_boundaries_format
docs.text: Description of the coordinate format used to encode boundary data in the roi_boundaries column. Examples include the OME ROI Polygon model (coordinates as "x1,y1 x2,y2 ...") and the OBJ 3D mesh format (vertex and face lists). Must be sufficient for unambiguous parsing of all roi_boundaries values in this file. Written as #ROI_Boundaries_Format: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: roi_mappings
docs.text: The complete collection of ROI boundary records constituting this dataset. Each ROIMapping corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: software_authors
docs.text: Author name(s) in 'Surname, Firstname' format, multiple authors separated by semicolons. Written as #Software_Authors:.

docs.title: Slot: software_description
docs.text: Free-text description of the algorithm and analysis parameters, sufficient to guarantee reproducibility. Written as #Software_Description:.

docs.title: Slot: software_preferred_citation_id
docs.text: Unique identifier (DOI, PMCID, ArXiv ID, etc.) for the primary publication describing this software. Written as #Software_PreferredCitationID:.

docs.title: Slot: software_repository
docs.text: URL of the repository where the software release can be obtained. Written as #Software_Repository:.

docs.title: Slot: software_title
docs.text: Name of the software tool. Written as #Software_Title:.

docs.title: Slot: software_type
docs.text: Functional category of the software tool. Written as #Software_Type:.

docs.title: Slot: softwares
docs.text: One or more Software entries documenting every tool used to produce or process data in this table. Written as repeating #Software* blocks in the file header._

docs.title: Slot: spot_biological_records
docs.text: The complete collection of SpotBiologicalRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation and must include at least one user-defined biological property column.

docs.title: Slot: spot_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for a bright DNA Spot. Used as a primary key in quality and biological data tables, and as a foreign key linking localization events to their parent Spot in the demultiplexing table.

docs.title: Slot: spot_quality_records
docs.text: The complete collection of SpotQualityRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation and must include at least one user-defined quality metric column.

docs.title: Slot: spots
docs.text: The complete collection of Spots constituting this dataset. Each Spot corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: sub_cell_roi_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for a sub-cellular structure ROI (e.g., nucleus, nucleolus). Links to the Sub-Cell ROI Data table.

docs.title: Slot: sub_cell_roi_type
docs.text: The type of sub-cellular structure ROI documented in this table or mapping file. It is recommended to use an EFO 'cellular_component' child term. Examples include Nucleolus, NL (nuclear lamina), NPC (nuclear pore complex), PML_body, Cajal_body, Chromosome_Domain. Written as #Sub_Cell_ROI_Type: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: sub_cell_rois
docs.text: The complete collection of sub-cellular ROIs constituting this dataset. Each SubCellROI corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation. At least one user-defined optional column (e.g. ROI_Volume, ROI_Area) MUST be present in every submitted Sub-Cell ROI Data table.

docs.title: Slot: table_namespace
docs.text: Identifier for this table type. The required value is specific to each table. Written as ##Table_Namespace= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: time_unit
docs.text: Unit used to represent time intervals in this table. Allowed values are SI time units plus 'min' and 'hr'. Written as ##Time_Unit= in the file header. Conditionally required when any time metric is reported.

docs.title: Slot: trace_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for a chromatin Trace. Used as a primary key in the Trace Data table and as a foreign key in the RNA Spot Data table.

docs.title: Slot: traces
docs.text: The complete collection of Traces constituting this dataset. Each Trace corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: transcript_id
docs.text: Official transcript identifier for the specific transcript targeted by the FISH probe. Conditionally required when multiple transcripts share the same gene_id and the FISH probe can distinguish among them. The type of identifier used must be declared in the transcript_id_type header field.

docs.title: Slot: transcript_id_type
docs.text: Type of transcript identifier used in the transcript_id column (e.g. Ensembl_V38, RefSeq). Conditionally required when multiple transcripts share the same gene_id and the FISH probe can distinguish among them. Written as ##Transcript_ID_Type= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: vcf_file_name
docs.text: Name of the Variant Call Format (VCF) file that must be submitted alongside the dataset to describe the genome insertion or deletion. Conditionally required when genome_assembly uses the 'custom-build:' prefix. Written as ##VCF_File_Name= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: vcf_version
docs.text: Version of the VCF format used for the accompanying VCF file. Conditionally required when genome_assembly uses the 'custom-build:' prefix. Written as ##VCF_Version= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: x
docs.text: Sub-pixel X coordinate of this detected event (Spot or localisation) in the unit specified by xyz_unit. The reported value is the final position after all post-processing corrections (drift correction, chromatic correction, etc.).

docs.title: Slot: x_chromatic_shift
docs.text: Chromatic aberration correction offset applied to the X coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as X.

docs.title: Slot: x_drift
docs.text: Drift correction offset applied to the X coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as X.

docs.title: Slot: x_loc_error
docs.text: Localization error estimate for the X coordinate of this Spot (e.g. standard deviation of repeated measurements). Same unit as X.

docs.title: Slot: x_precision
docs.text: Metric quantifying the precision of the X-axis localization estimate. Typically the Cramer-Rao lower bound or Thompson method estimate. Recommended in the Spot Quality table; mandatory in the SM Localization Quality table. Must be accompanied by a description in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: xyz_unit
docs.text: Unit used to represent X, Y, Z spatial coordinates or distances in this table. Use 'micron' to avoid issues with Greek symbols. Values should be drawn from SI units of length. Written as ##XYZ_Unit= in the file header. Conditionally required when any location or distance metric is reported.

docs.title: Slot: y
docs.text: Sub-pixel Y coordinate of this detected event (Spot or localisation) in the unit specified by xyz_unit. The reported value is the final position after all post-processing corrections.

docs.title: Slot: y_chromatic_shift
docs.text: Chromatic aberration correction offset applied to the Y coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Y.

docs.title: Slot: y_drift
docs.text: Drift correction offset applied to the Y coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Y.

docs.title: Slot: y_loc_error
docs.text: Localization error estimate for the Y coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Y.

docs.title: Slot: y_precision
docs.text: Metric quantifying the precision of the Y-axis localization estimate. Recommended in the Spot Quality table; mandatory in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: z
docs.text: Sub-pixel Z coordinate of this detected event (Spot or localisation) in the unit specified by xyz_unit. The reported value is the final position after all post-processing corrections.

docs.title: Slot: z_chromatic_shift
docs.text: Chromatic aberration correction offset applied to the Z coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Z.

docs.title: Slot: z_drift
docs.text: Drift correction offset applied to the Z coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Z.

docs.title: Slot: z_loc_error
docs.text: Localization error estimate for the Z coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Z.

docs.title: Slot: z_precision
docs.text: Metric quantifying the precision of the Z-axis localization estimate. Recommended in the Spot Quality table; mandatory in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: FISH Omics Format for Chromatin Tracing - Volumetric modality (FOF-vol-CT)

Root schema for the FISH Omics Format for Chromatin Tracing - Volumetric modality (FOF-vol-CT). Imports all twelve FOF-bas-CT table schemas plus the three FOF-vol-CT-specific table schemas. In FOF-vol-CT, the SM Localization Data table and SM Localization Quality table are mandatory; the Spot/Trace Data table is optional post-processing output.

URI: https://w3id.org/fof-ct/vol

Name: fof_vol_ct

docs.title: Class: Cell
docs.text: A single Cell identified in a FOF-bas-CT experiment. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT Cell Data table. The cell_id field uniquely identifies each Cell and links to the core table, the Sub-Cell ROI Data table, and the Cell/ROI Mapping table. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns (e.g. Cell_Size, Cell_Volume, Cell_Cycle_State, RNA_Spot_Count) via open schema. At least one such user-defined column MUST be present per submission.

docs.title: Class: CellTable
docs.text: The Cell Data table of a FOF-bas-CT dataset (namespace: 4dn_FOF-CT_cell). This class represents the entire file: it holds all dataset-level provenance metadata (recorded as header lines in the TSV serialisation) together with the full collection of Cells (recorded as data rows). This table is optional but recommended. Analogous to the MappingSet class in SSSOM.

docs.title: Class: ExtraCellROI
docs.text: A single extracellular structure ROI (e.g. a tissue section or organoid) identified in a FOF-bas-CT experiment. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT Extra-Cell ROI Data table. The extra_cell_roi_id field uniquely identifies each ROI and links to the core table, the RNA Spot Data table, and the Cell Data table. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns (e.g. ROI_Volume, Cell_Count). At least one such user-defined column MUST be present per submission.

docs.title: Class: Localization
docs.text: A single individual localisation event contributing to the final position of a bright DNA Spot in a multiplexed FISH experiment (e.g. MERFISH). Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the CSV data section of the FOF-CT Spot Demultiplexing table. The spot_id field links each Localization to its parent Spot in the core table (or RNA Spot Data table); it may be NA when the localisation could not be assigned to any Spot. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns (e.g. Hyb, Brightness, Fit_Quality).

docs.title: Class: RNASpot
docs.text: A single detected RNA bright Spot corresponding to one RNA transcript location detected alongside Chromatin Tracing. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the CSV data section of the FOF-CT RNA Spot Data table. The rna_spot_id links each RNASpot to the RNA Quality and RNA Biological Data tables; the trace_id links this RNA Spot to a DNA chromatin Trace in the core table and Trace Data table. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns via open schema.

docs.text: A single row in the RNA Spot Quality table. Each instance captures one or more quality metrics for a specific RNA bright Spot identified by RNA_Spot_ID. RNA_Spot_ID values must be unique across the dataset, linking to the corresponding record in the RNA Spot Data table (table 4). At least one user-defined quality metric column MUST be present; users declare these via #^ header lines.

docs.title: Class: ROIMapping
docs.text: A single boundary record for one Cell, Sub-Cell ROI, or Extra-Cell ROI in a FOF-bas-CT experiment. Each instance corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT Cell/ROI Mapping table. Exactly one of the three identifier slots (sub_cell_roi_id, cell_id, extra_cell_roi_id) must be populated per file; the choice of identifier must be consistent across all rows of a given submission. The roi_boundaries slot holds the boundary coordinates in the format specified by roi_boundaries_format in the table header. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns.

docs.title: Class: ROIMappingTable
docs.text: The Cell/ROI Mapping table of a FOF-bas-CT dataset (namespace: 4dn_FOF-CT_mapping). This class represents the entire file: it holds all dataset-level provenance metadata (recorded as header lines in the TSV serialisation) together with the full collection of ROI boundary records (recorded as data rows). This table is conditionally required whenever a Cell Data table, a Sub-Cell ROI Data table, or an Extra-Cell ROI Data table is deposited. Analogous to the MappingSet class in SSSOM.

docs.title: Class: SMLocalization
docs.text: A single individual single-molecule (SM) localization event in a FOF-vol-CT dataset. Each instance corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the SM Localization Data table. The loc_id field is the primary key; spot_id links this localization to its parent Spot (if Spot/Trace post-processing was performed); trace_id links it to its parent Trace. Sub_Cell_ROI_ID, Cell_ID and Extra_Cell_ROI_ID optionally link the localization to spatial context tables.

docs.title: Class: SubCellROI
docs.text: A single sub-cellular structure ROI (e.g. nucleolus, nuclear lamina, PML body, chromosome domain) identified in a FOF-bas-CT experiment. Each instance of this class corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the FOF-CT Sub-Cell ROI Data table. The sub_cell_roi_id field uniquely identifies each ROI and links to the core table, the Cell Data table, and the Cell/ROI Mapping table. This class accepts additional user-defined optional columns (e.g. ROI_Volume, ROI_Area). At least one such user-defined column MUST be present per submission.

User-defined columns are accommodated via open schema.

docs.title: Class: UndecodedLocalization
docs.text: A single raw, undecoded SM localization event in a FOF-vol-CT dataset. Each instance corresponds to one row in the TSV data section of the Undecoded SM Localization Data table. This class uses LocalizationMixin for the shared loc_id, x, y, z slots. The frame_id column identifies the source imaging frame; fluor identifies the detection channel.

docs.title: Enum: XYZUnitEnum
docs.text: Allowed units for X, Y, Z spatial coordinates or distances.

docs.title: Slot: additional_tables
docs.text: List of additional FOF-CT table namespaces being submitted alongside this table, separated by commas in the TSV header. Written as #Additional_Tables: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: cell_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for a Cell. Links to the Cell Data table.

docs.title: Slot: cell_type
docs.text: The type of cells present in this dataset, expressed using an ontology term from the Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO). Examples include "Cell in tissue" or "Cell in organoid". Written as #Cell_Type: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: cells
docs.text: The complete collection of Cells constituting this dataset. Each Cell corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation. At least one user-defined optional column (e.g. Cell_Size, Cell_Volume) MUST be present in every submitted Cell Data table.

docs.title: Slot: centroid_intensity
docs.text: Signal intensity of the centroid pixel of the Spot. Conditionally required in the Spot Quality table when intensity metrics are reported.

docs.title: Slot: channel_name
docs.text: The name of the imaging channel used for this Spot (e.g. 510/25). Mandatory in the Spot Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: chrom
docs.text: Chromosome name using BED (Browser Extensible Data) convention (e.g., chr3, chrY, chr2_random).

docs.title: Slot: chrom_end
docs.text: Non-inclusive end coordinate on the chromosome for the genomic target sequence associated with this Spot, following BED convention.

docs.title: Slot: chrom_start
docs.text: 0-based start coordinate on the chromosome for the genomic target sequence associated with this Spot, following BED convention.

docs.title: Slot: description
docs.text: Free-text description of the experiment and of the data recorded in this table. Should provide sufficient detail for interpretation and reproducibility. Written as #Description: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: experimenter_contact
docs.text: Email address of the person who performed the experiment. Written as #Experimenter_Contact: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: experimenter_name
docs.text: Full name of the person who performed the experiment. Written as #Experimenter_Name: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: extra_cell_roi_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for an extracellular structure ROI (e.g., tissue, organoid). Links to the Extra-Cell ROI Data table.

docs.title: Slot: extra_cell_roi_type
docs.text: The type of extracellular structure ROI within which cells are embedded, expressed using an EFO 'organism part' child term (e.g. Tissue, Organoid). Conditionally required when extracellular structure ROIs are identified and reported in a dedicated Extra-Cell ROI Data table. Written as #Extra_Cell_ROI_Type: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: extra_cell_rois
docs.text: The complete collection of extracellular ROIs constituting this dataset. Each ExtraCellROI corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation. At least one user-defined optional column (e.g. ROI_Volume, Cell_Count) MUST be present in every submitted Extra-Cell ROI Data table.

docs.title: Slot: fluor
docs.text: Fluorescent channel in which this localization event was detected (e.g. DAPI, GFP, Cy5, Alexa647). Mandatory in both the Spot Demultiplexing and Undecoded SM Localization tables.

docs.title: Slot: fluorophore_name
docs.text: The name of the fluorophore used for this Spot (e.g. AlexaFluor_488). Mandatory in the Spot Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: fof_ct_version
docs.text: Version of the FOF-CT format used in this file. Always the first line of the file header (##FOF-CT_Version=).

docs.title: fof_vol_ct
docs.text:
Root schema for the FISH Omics Format for Chromatin Tracing - Volumetric modality (FOF-vol-CT). Imports all twelve FOF-bas-CT table schemas plus the three FOF-vol-CT-specific table schemas. In FOF-vol-CT, the SM Localization Data table and SM Localization Quality table are mandatory; the Spot/Trace Data table is optional post-processing output.

URI: https://w3id.org/fof-ct/vol

docs.title: Slot: frame_id
docs.text: Unique integer identifier for the imaging frame in which this undecoded localization event was detected. Used in the Undecoded SM Localization table.

docs.title: Slot: gene_id
docs.text: Official gene identifier corresponding to rna_name. The type of identifier used (e.g. Ensembl gene ID, NCBI Gene ID) must be declared in the gene_id_type header field.

docs.title: Slot: gene_id_type
docs.text: Type of gene identifier used in the gene_id column (e.g. Ensembl_V38, NCBI_Gene). Written as ##Gene_ID_Type= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: genome_assembly
docs.text: Genome build used for Chrom, Chrom_Start and Chrom_End coordinates. The 4DN Data Portal accepts GRCh38 (human) and GRCm38 (mouse). When the genome under study contains an INSERTION or DELETION the value must use the mandatory 'custom-build:' prefix followed by a descriptive name (e.g., custom-build:GRCm38+pJT039(insertion)). Written as ##Genome_Assembly= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: goodness_of_fit
docs.text: Metric quantifying how well the fitted model matches the observed signal (e.g. chi-squared, R-squared). Optional (but standardised name) in the Spot Quality table; recommended in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: intensity_measurement_method
docs.text: Method used to perform intensity measurements, including how digital signals were converted to photon counts. Written as #Intensity_Measurement_Method: in the file header. Conditionally required when any intensity metric is reported.

docs.title: Slot: intensity_unit
docs.text: Unit used to represent intensity measurements in this table. Written as ##Intensity_Unit= in the file header. Conditionally required when any intensity metric is reported.

docs.title: Slot: lab_name
docs.text: Name of the laboratory where the experiment was performed. Written as #Lab_Name: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: loc_id
docs.text: A unique integer identifier for an individual localization event. Loc_ID values are unique across the entire dataset. Serves as primary key in the Spot Demultiplexing, SM Localization Data, and Undecoded SM Localization tables, and as a foreign key in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: localizations
docs.text: The complete collection of Localization events constituting this dataset. Each Localization corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: modification
docs.text: Description of the nature and genomic position of a DNA insertion or deletion in the genome under study. Conditionally required when genome_assembly uses the 'custom-build:' prefix. Written as ##Modification= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: peak_intensity
docs.text: Signal intensity of the brightest pixel within the Spot boundary. Conditionally required in the Spot Quality table when intensity metrics are reported.

docs.title: Slot: photon_count
docs.text: Number of photons detected for this localization event or Spot. Optional (but standardised name) in the Spot Quality table; recommended in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: raw_x
docs.text: X coordinate of this Spot before any post-processing corrections (drift correction, chromatic correction, etc.). Same unit as X.

docs.title: Slot: raw_y
docs.text: Y coordinate of this Spot before any post-processing corrections. Same unit as Y.

docs.title: Slot: raw_z
docs.text: Z coordinate of this Spot before any post-processing corrections. Same unit as Z.

docs.title: Slot: rna_name
docs.text: Official name of the gene from which the targeted RNA is transcribed (e.g. ACTB, GAPDH). Should follow HGNC (human) or MGI (mouse) gene nomenclature.

docs.title: Slot: rna_spot_biological_records
docs.text: The complete collection of RNASpotBiologicalRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation and must include at least one user-defined biological property column.

docs.title: Slot: rna_spot_id
docs.text: Unique integer identifier for an RNA bright Spot, unique across the entire dataset. Used as a primary key in the RNA Spot Data table and as a foreign key in the RNA Quality and RNA Biological Data tables.

docs.title: Slot: rna_spot_quality_records
docs.text: The complete collection of RNASpotQualityRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation and must include at least one user-defined quality metric column.

docs.title: Slot: rna_spots
docs.text: The complete collection of RNA Spots constituting this dataset. Each RNASpot corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: roi_boundaries
docs.text: Boundary coordinates for this Cell or ROI, encoded in the format specified by roi_boundaries_format in the table header. For the OME ROI Polygon model, coordinates are provided as a space-separated list of "x,y" pairs (e.g. "12.5,40.2 13.1,41.0 ..."). For OBJ 3D mesh format, the field contains the vertex and face list for the boundary mesh.

docs.title: Slot: roi_boundaries_format
docs.text: Description of the coordinate format used to encode boundary data in the roi_boundaries column. Examples include the OME ROI Polygon model (coordinates as "x1,y1 x2,y2 ...") and the OBJ 3D mesh format (vertex and face lists). Must be sufficient for unambiguous parsing of all roi_boundaries values in this file. Written as #ROI_Boundaries_Format: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: roi_mappings
docs.text: The complete collection of ROI boundary records constituting this dataset. Each ROIMapping corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: sm_localization_quality_records
docs.text: The complete collection of SMLocalizationQualityRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: sm_localizations
docs.text: The complete collection of SMLocalization events constituting this dataset. Each entry corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: software_authors
docs.text: Author name(s) in 'Surname, Firstname' format, multiple authors separated by semicolons. Written as #Software_Authors:.

docs.title: Slot: software_description
docs.text: Free-text description of the algorithm and analysis parameters, sufficient to guarantee reproducibility. Written as #Software_Description:.

docs.title: Slot: software_preferred_citation_id
docs.text: Unique identifier (DOI, PMCID, ArXiv ID, etc.) for the primary publication describing this software. Written as #Software_PreferredCitationID:.

docs.title: Slot: software_repository
docs.text: URL of the repository where the software release can be obtained. Written as #Software_Repository:.

docs.title: Slot: software_title
docs.text: Name of the software tool. Written as #Software_Title:.

docs.title: Slot: software_type
docs.text: Functional category of the software tool. Written as #Software_Type:.

docs.title: Slot: softwares
docs.text: One or more Software entries documenting every tool used to produce or process data in this table. Written as repeating #Software* blocks in the file header._

docs.title: Slot: spot_biological_records
docs.text: The complete collection of SpotBiologicalRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation and must include at least one user-defined biological property column.

docs.title: Slot: spot_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for a bright DNA Spot. Used as a primary key in quality and biological data tables, and as a foreign key linking localization events to their parent Spot in the demultiplexing table.

docs.title: Slot: spot_quality_records
docs.text: The complete collection of SpotQualityRecord rows constituting this dataset. Each record corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation and must include at least one user-defined quality metric column.

docs.title: Slot: spots
docs.text: The complete collection of Spots constituting this dataset. Each Spot corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: sub_cell_roi_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for a sub-cellular structure ROI (e.g., nucleus, nucleolus). Links to the Sub-Cell ROI Data table.

docs.title: Slot: sub_cell_roi_type
docs.text: The type of sub-cellular structure ROI documented in this table or mapping file. It is recommended to use an EFO 'cellular_component' child term. Examples include Nucleolus, NL (nuclear lamina), NPC (nuclear pore complex), PML_body, Cajal_body, Chromosome_Domain. Written as #Sub_Cell_ROI_Type: in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: sub_cell_rois
docs.text: The complete collection of sub-cellular ROIs constituting this dataset. Each SubCellROI corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation. At least one user-defined optional column (e.g. ROI_Volume, ROI_Area) MUST be present in every submitted Sub-Cell ROI Data table.

docs.title: Slot: table_namespace
docs.text: Identifier for this table type. The required value is specific to each table. Written as ##Table_Namespace= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: time_unit
docs.text: Unit used to represent time intervals in this table. Allowed values are SI time units plus 'min' and 'hr'. Written as ##Time_Unit= in the file header. Conditionally required when any time metric is reported.

docs.title: Slot: trace_id
docs.text: Unique identifier for a chromatin Trace. Used as a primary key in the Trace Data table and as a foreign key in the RNA Spot Data table.

docs.title: Slot: traces
docs.text: The complete collection of Traces constituting this dataset. Each Trace corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: transcript_id
docs.text: Official transcript identifier for the specific transcript targeted by the FISH probe. Conditionally required when multiple transcripts share the same gene_id and the FISH probe can distinguish among them. The type of identifier used must be declared in the transcript_id_type header field.

docs.title: Slot: transcript_id_type
docs.text: Type of transcript identifier used in the transcript_id column (e.g. Ensembl_V38, RefSeq). Conditionally required when multiple transcripts share the same gene_id and the FISH probe can distinguish among them. Written as ##Transcript_ID_Type= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: undecoded_localizations
docs.text: The complete collection of UndecodedLocalization events constituting this dataset. Each entry corresponds to one data row in the TSV serialisation.

docs.title: Slot: vcf_file_name
docs.text: Name of the Variant Call Format (VCF) file that must be submitted alongside the dataset to describe the genome insertion or deletion. Conditionally required when genome_assembly uses the 'custom-build:' prefix. Written as ##VCF_File_Name= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: vcf_version
docs.text: Version of the VCF format used for the accompanying VCF file. Conditionally required when genome_assembly uses the 'custom-build:' prefix. Written as ##VCF_Version= in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: x
docs.text: Sub-pixel X coordinate of this detected event (Spot or localisation) in the unit specified by xyz_unit. The reported value is the final position after all post-processing corrections (drift correction, chromatic correction, etc.).

docs.title: Slot: x_chromatic_shift
docs.text: Chromatic aberration correction offset applied to the X coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as X.

docs.title: Slot: x_drift
docs.text: Drift correction offset applied to the X coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as X.

docs.title: Slot: x_loc_error
docs.text: Localization error estimate for the X coordinate of this Spot (e.g. standard deviation of repeated measurements). Same unit as X.

docs.title: Slot: x_precision
docs.text: Metric quantifying the precision of the X-axis localization estimate. Typically the Cramer-Rao lower bound or Thompson method estimate. Recommended in the Spot Quality table; mandatory in the SM Localization Quality table. Must be accompanied by a description in the file header.

docs.title: Slot: xyz_unit
docs.text: Unit used to represent X, Y, Z spatial coordinates or distances in this table. Use 'micron' to avoid issues with Greek symbols. Values should be drawn from SI units of length. Written as ##XYZ_Unit= in the file header. Conditionally required when any location or distance metric is reported.

docs.title: Slot: y
docs.text: Sub-pixel Y coordinate of this detected event (Spot or localisation) in the unit specified by xyz_unit. The reported value is the final position after all post-processing corrections.

docs.title: Slot: y_chromatic_shift
docs.text: Chromatic aberration correction offset applied to the Y coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Y.

docs.title: Slot: y_drift
docs.text: Drift correction offset applied to the Y coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Y.

docs.title: Slot: y_loc_error
docs.text: Localization error estimate for the Y coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Y.

docs.title: Slot: y_precision
docs.text: Metric quantifying the precision of the Y-axis localization estimate. Recommended in the Spot Quality table; mandatory in the SM Localization Quality table.

docs.title: Slot: z
docs.text: Sub-pixel Z coordinate of this detected event (Spot or localisation) in the unit specified by xyz_unit. The reported value is the final position after all post-processing corrections.

docs.title: Slot: z_chromatic_shift
docs.text: Chromatic aberration correction offset applied to the Z coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Z.

docs.title: Slot: z_drift
docs.text: Drift correction offset applied to the Z coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Z.

docs.title: Slot: z_loc_error
docs.text: Localization error estimate for the Z coordinate of this Spot. Same unit as Z.

docs.title: Slot: z_precision
docs.text: Metric quantifying the precision of the Z-axis localization estimate. Recommended in the Spot Quality table; mandatory in the SM Localization Quality table.
